messages:
leila: Quick thread 1: CortexBank wants a 2-week POC to replace FastGenAPI with Redwood. Core asks: identical request shape, mapped finish_reason, and a parity report on ~150 finance prompts. Can we scope dedicated + adapter?
dave: yes. We'll build a small shim to accept FastGenAPI endpoints and translate to Redwood. Main risks: stop-token semantics, default temperature/top_p, and extra metadata fields (they expect trace_id + model_version).
hiro: Parity plan: run 150 prompts across 4 categories (short, regulatory/legal, multi-turn forms, tabular extraction). Metrics: token overlap, structural field fidelity, and edge-case hallucination count. Deliverable: delta report + example fixes.
leila: Pricing: they want POC cost + committed monthly for steady state (peak ~40 rps). Any back-of-envelope?
dave: POC (2x mid-GPU dedicated) ~ $5.5k/week. For steady 40 rps we'll propose committed units + overage rates; I'll draft a simple price sheet.
monica: Security note: they attached a vendor risk PDF. Need SOC2, encryption-at-rest KMS details, subprocessor list, and ability to keep logs in eu-central. I can prepare answers but need the PDF.
leila: functional: FastGenAPI streams chunks with chunk_index + truncated flag. Their infra expects truncated==true for length cuts. Can adapter emit those?
dave: yes 1: map our finish_reason=="length" -> truncated=true, and keep chunk_index. Also set explicit params in shim to match their defaults to reduce diffs.
dave: adapter snippet (curl):
```bash
# incoming FastGenAPI-like call
curl -X POST https://api.fastgen/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Summarize...","max_tokens":80}'
# adapter -> Redwood
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -d '{"input":"Summarize...","max_new_tokens":80}'
```
hiro: I'll run the harness once adapter prototype is up. Need their prompt corpus and a list of critical failure cases.
monica: if they insist on VPC + customer KMS for POC, provisioning is +5 business days. Recommend shared-dedicated for speed.
sec-bot: Ticket created: SEC-7783 vendor questionnaire assigned to monica.
dave: action items: (1) leila: upload vendor PDF + prompt corpus, (2) monica: draft security responses, (3) hiro: parity harness ready, (4) dave: adapter scaffold. Sync EOD tomorrow.
leila: I'll get the docs and contact (secops@cortexbank.com). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
